title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
description: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
description: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
description: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
description: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
description: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
description: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
description: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
description: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
description: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
description: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
description: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
description: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
description: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
description: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
description: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.

title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
description: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
description: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
description: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
description: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
description: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

title: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
description: Anthropic’s IPO made FTX’s liquidated AI bet a $43 billion what-if, just as Netflix premiered its Sam Bankman-Fried drama.

title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
description: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
description: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
description: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.

title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
description: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
description: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
description: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60K as Crypto Fear Index Hits Worst Level Since February
description: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 Friday as crypto sentiment collapsed and AI-linked stocks sank after Anthropic’s IPO.

title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
description: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
description: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
description: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.

title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
description: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

title: Former Point72 head of proprietary research says AI could turn data into a new asset class for Wall Street
description: A former Point72 executive says AI could reshape Wall Street's data market, turning once-exclusive information into a source of revenue and financing.

title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
description: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
description: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
description: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
description: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

title: Morning Minute: Anthropic IPO Pops, Sinks Markets
description: A (brief) win for Anthropic's ANT stock on IPO day meant a loss for just about every other major asset class.

title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
description: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
description: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

title: Bitcoin, stocks and gold traders getting nervous, and volatility gauges are surging
description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 20, 2026

title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
description: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $582M in a Day as BTC Drops Below $62K
description: Thursday's ETF outflow was the funds' biggest in three weeks, as rising Treasury yields and Fed rate hike bets weigh on crypto.

title: Bitcoin drops for third straight day as Asian tech shares slide
description: BlackRock’s spot bitcoin ETF recorded the largest single-day outflow since its introduction more than two years ago as investors continued to flee the sector.

title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
description: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

title: Coinbase Targets In-House Prediction Markets by First Half of 2027: Report
description: The exchange offers event contracts through Kalshi, but running its own would give it more control and a bigger share of trading revenue.

title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
description: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
description: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
description: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
description: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
description: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
description: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
description: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
description: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
description: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.

title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
description: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
description: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
description: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.
